preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two nodes within the range from 1 to n.
The graph is guaranteed to be connected, meaning there is a path between any two nodes.

postconditions.description: The output is a permutation of nodes of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in range(1, n+1) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each node in the output is a valid node number.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] != output[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
postconditions.description: The output contains no repeated nodes.
The output is the lexicographically smallest permutation of nodes that can be recorded by Bob while wandering the graph.
